comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
If you haven't done so already, you may wish to consult a player-written guide on Nanban Trade, found here:

uwomarcos.blogspot.com/2013/09/nanban-trading-basics.html

It's divided into several sections, and gives some excellent information on a number of Nanban topics.

As to your question, according to the Nanban Trade section on this database (see it on the upper-left menu among the many linked sections?), those specific trade goods appear in Korea's markets when you have reached 37,000 (Raspberry) and 43,000 (Cactus) Korean cultural contribution points.
